summary: Comprehensive architectural and product implementation plan for Aladdin Forex Sniper (अलादीन फॉरेक्स स्नाइपर). Outlines the transition from binary options to a real-time Live Forex & Gold Signal Generator and Scanner, removing the redundant mini chart, integrating real-time technical confluence algorithms on the full-screen TradingView chart, and deploying an actionable Floating Sniper HUD with Entry, SL, TP, and crisp audio voice alerts.
